label: Batch freezer (ice cream)
source: Commercial foodservice dealer listings, 2024. Used prices carry no warranty and typically no installation.

label: Commercial range and hood
source: Restaurant equipment dealer ranges, 2024. Hood and suppression are usually the larger half and are frequently forgotten.

label: Walk-in cooler
source: Dealer quotes, 2024. Installed price includes the condensing unit and the electrical run, which the box price does not.

label: Restaurant buildout per square foot
source: US restaurant construction cost surveys, 2023-24. A second-generation space with usable hood, grease trap and gas service is the single largest saving available.

label: Point-of-sale system
source: Vendor list pricing, 2024. Hardware only; the monthly software fee is a separate recurring line.

label: Line cook, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 35-2014 median wages by metro, 2024, grossed up for payroll load. Fully loaded means employer taxes, workers' comp and any benefits — typically 12-18% on top of wage.

label: Server, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 35-3031 plus state tip-credit rules, 2024. Whether the state allows a tip credit moves this line more than anything else about the business.

label: Ready-mix mixer truck
source: Heavy truck dealer and auction listings, 2024. Drum condition and remaining engine life drive the spread far more than year.

label: Box truck or work van
source: Commercial vehicle listings, 2024. Upfit — shelving, ladder rack, wrap — typically adds $4-9k and is usually omitted.

label: Licensed tradesperson, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 47-2152 and 47-2111 medians, 2024, grossed up for payroll load and workers' comp — which for trades runs far above the 4% typical of office work.

label: General liability insurance per year
source: Broker quote ranges, 2024. Liquor liability and any work at height move this by multiples, not percentages.

label: Commercial rent per square foot per year
source: Brokerage market reports, 2024. Triple-net adds taxes, insurance and common-area maintenance on top — often another 20-30%.

label: Self-storage buildout per unit
source: Self-storage development cost surveys, 2023-24, excluding land. Climate control roughly doubles both the buildout and the utility line.

label: Software engineer, fully loaded per quarter
source: Levels.fyi and BLS 15-1252 medians, 2024, grossed up for payroll load and benefits. Equity is not in this figure and does not reduce it.

label: Cloud hosting per quarter
source: Published list pricing, 2024. Egress and managed database are the lines that surprise people, not compute.

label: Card processing rate
source: Interchange plus typical processor markup, 2024. Card-not-present is structurally dearer and no amount of negotiating closes that gap.

label: Dishwasher, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 35-9021 medians, 2024, grossed up for payroll load. Almost always the lowest-paid station in the kitchen and the highest-turnover one.

label: Kitchen manager / sous chef, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 35-1011 and posted salary ranges, 2024, grossed up. The step between this and a line cook is the step from hourly to salaried.

label: Restaurant general manager, fully loaded per quarter
source: Posted salary ranges, 2024, grossed up. Usually the largest single payroll line an owner-absent restaurant carries.

label: Barista, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS occupational wage data, 2024, grossed up for payroll load — employer taxes, workers' comp and any benefits, typically 12-18% on top of wage. Tips are on top and are the reason the wage holds below fast food in some markets.

label: Bartender, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 35-3011 plus state tip-credit rules, 2024. As with servers, whether the state allows a tip credit moves this more than the market does.

label: Head brewer, fully loaded per quarter
source: Brewers Association salary survey ranges, 2024, grossed up. Small breweries under ~3,000 bbl usually run one brewer and an assistant.

label: Quick-service crew member, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS occupational wage data, 2024, grossed up for payroll load — employer taxes, workers' comp and any benefits, typically 12-18% on top of wage. California fast-food minimums sit at the top of this band.

label: Shift supervisor, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS occupational wage data, 2024, grossed up for payroll load — employer taxes, workers' comp and any benefits, typically 12-18% on top of wage.

label: Baker, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 51-3011 medians, 2024, grossed up. Overnight shifts carry a premium the band includes.

label: Retail sales associate, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 41-2031 medians, 2024, grossed up for payroll load. Commission structures where they exist sit on top.

label: Retail store manager, fully loaded per quarter
source: Posted salary ranges, 2024, grossed up for payroll load and the typical store-level bonus.

label: Warehouse associate, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS occupational wage data, 2024, grossed up for payroll load — employer taxes, workers' comp and any benefits, typically 12-18% on top of wage.

label: Delivery driver (light vehicle), fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS occupational wage data, 2024, grossed up for payroll load — employer taxes, workers' comp and any benefits, typically 12-18% on top of wage. Excludes the vehicle; commercial auto insurance is its own line.

label: CDL truck driver, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 53-3032 medians, 2024, grossed up. Mixer and tanker endorsements carry a premium, and workers’ comp for drivers runs far above office rates.

label: Heavy equipment operator, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 47-2073 medians, 2024, grossed up including construction-class workers’ comp.

label: Construction laborer, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 47-2061 medians, 2024, grossed up including construction-class workers’ comp — which is most of the gap over comparable indoor work.

label: Landscape crew member, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS occupational wage data, 2024, grossed up for payroll load — employer taxes, workers' comp and any benefits, typically 12-18% on top of wage. Seasonal markets compress the working year, not the quarterly rate.

label: Janitorial / cleaning staff, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 37-2011 medians, 2024, grossed up for payroll load. Contracted services price per square foot instead — see the recurring lines.

label: Receptionist / office admin, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 43-4171 medians, 2024, grossed up for payroll load.

label: Staff bookkeeper, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 43-3031 medians, 2024, grossed up. An outsourced service is usually cheaper below ~20 hours a week — that is its own catalog line.

label: Customer support rep, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 43-4051 medians and BPO per-seat pricing, 2024. The offshore tier is a vendor invoice, not payroll — no load applies, and quality is the trade.

label: Inside sales rep, fully loaded per quarter (base only)
source: Posted base ranges, 2024, grossed up. Commission is deliberately excluded — model it as a variable cost against revenue, not payroll.

label: Account executive, fully loaded per quarter (base only)
source: Posted B2B base ranges, 2024, grossed up. OTE roughly doubles this; the variable half belongs in cost of sales.

label: Recruiter, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 13-1071 medians, 2024, grossed up for payroll load. Agency recruiters bill 15-25% of first-year salary instead, which is a variable cost.

label: Graphic designer, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 27-1024 medians, 2024, grossed up for payroll load. Freelance rates of $50-120/hr are the common alternative below full-time need.

label: Product / UX designer, fully loaded per quarter
source: Posted salary ranges, 2024, grossed up. Tracks software engineering pay more closely than graphic design.

label: Data analyst, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 15-2051 medians, 2024, grossed up for payroll load and benefits.

label: QA tester, fully loaded per quarter
source: Posted ranges, 2024, grossed up. Games and software QA pay well below development, which is why it is often the first hire after the founders stop testing their own builds.

label: Personal trainer, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 39-9031 medians, 2024, grossed up. Many gyms pay per session instead — if so this is a variable cost, not a block.

label: Gym front desk, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS occupational wage data, 2024, grossed up for payroll load — employer taxes, workers' comp and any benefits, typically 12-18% on top of wage.

label: Dog daycare attendant, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS occupational wage data, 2024, grossed up for payroll load — employer taxes, workers' comp and any benefits, typically 12-18% on top of wage. Ratios are the constraint: one attendant per 10-15 dogs is the insurable norm, which makes this a true step-fixed line.

label: Pet groomer, fully loaded per quarter
source: Posted ranges, 2024, grossed up. Commission splits of 40-60% of service revenue are common and turn this into a variable cost.

label: Hotel housekeeper, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 37-2012 medians, 2024, grossed up. Rule of thumb is 12-16 rooms cleaned per shift, which sets the blocks-per-occupied-room arithmetic.

label: Hotel front desk agent, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 43-4081 medians, 2024, grossed up for payroll load. A 24-hour desk is 4.2 full-time-equivalents, not three shifts.

label: Night auditor, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 43-4081 plus overnight differential, 2024, grossed up. A limited-service hotel cannot legally run unstaffed overnight, which makes this block a true minimum.

label: Property maintenance tech, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 49-9071 medians, 2024, grossed up for payroll load. One tech per 60-100 hotel rooms or 150-250 storage units is the staffing norm.

label: Security guard, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 33-9032 medians, 2024, grossed up for payroll load. Contract guard services bill $25-45/hr and carry the liability themselves.

label: Hair stylist, fully loaded per quarter (employee model)
source: BLS 39-5012 medians, 2024, grossed up. Booth rental flips this line entirely: the stylist becomes a tenant paying you $150-400 a week instead of a cost.

label: Massage therapist, fully loaded per quarter (employee model)
source: BLS 31-9011 medians, 2024, grossed up. Per-service pay of $25-50 per massage is the more common structure and is variable, not step-fixed.

label: Childcare worker, fully loaded per quarter
source: BLS 39-9011 medians, 2024, grossed up. State-mandated ratios (1:4 infants, 1:10+ preschool) make staffing a hard function of enrollment mix.

label: Instructor / tutor, fully loaded per quarter
source: Posted ranges across tutoring, music and enrichment, 2024, grossed up. Per-session contractor pay is the common alternative and is variable.

label: Commercial espresso machine
source: Specialty coffee equipment dealer listings, 2024. Installation wants a dedicated water line and often a filtration system at $500-1,500 more.

label: Commercial coffee grinder
source: Dealer listings, 2024. Busy shops run two — one for espresso, one for batch.

label: Shop coffee roaster
source: Roaster manufacturer list prices and used listings, 2024. Ventilation and afterburner requirements can add five figures in some jurisdictions.

label: Reach-in cooler
source: Restaurant equipment dealer listings, 2024. A fifth the price of a walk-in and the thing a bare "cooler" usually means.

label: Reach-in freezer
source: Restaurant equipment dealer listings, 2024. Used units carry no warranty on the compressor, which is most of the value.

label: Commercial ice machine
source: Dealer listings, 2024. Leasing at $100-200/month is common and moves this to a fixed cost.

label: Commercial dish machine
source: Dealer listings, 2024. Chemical-rinse lease programs at $150-300/month with detergent contracts are the common alternative to owning.

label: Convection oven
source: Restaurant equipment dealer listings, 2024. Combi ovens with steam sit at the top of the band and want a water line.

label: Pizza oven
source: Dealer and importer listings, 2024. Wood-fired installs add flue and clearance work that can rival the oven.

label: Commercial fryer
source: Restaurant equipment dealer listings, 2024. Built-in filtration halves oil spend, which pays the price gap back within a year at volume.

label: Draft beer system
source: Draft installer quotes, 2024. Long-draw glycol runs are priced per foot and per tap; the walk-in it pulls from is a separate line.

label: Brewhouse
source: Brewing equipment manufacturer quotes and used listings, 2024. Turnkey with fermenters roughly doubles the brewhouse-only figure.

label: Fermenter (unitank)
source: Manufacturer quotes and used listings, 2024. Count them against annual barrelage — fermenter capacity, not the brewhouse, usually caps output.

label: Half-barrel keg, each
source: Keg supplier pricing, 2024. A self-distributing brewpub needs roughly 2-3 kegs in circulation per tap handle sold.

label: Glycol chiller
source: Manufacturer quotes, 2024. Sized to fermenter count; undersizing shows up as lost batches, not higher bills.

label: Grease trap / interceptor, installed
source: Plumbing contractor quotes, 2024. Many jurisdictions size it by fixture count and will not open a kitchen without it.

label: Food truck, complete build
source: Builder quotes and resale listings, 2024. Commissary rent, permits and generator fuel are the recurring lines people forget.

label: Spiral / planetary dough mixer
source: Bakery equipment dealer listings, 2024. Spiral mixers handle stiff doughs a planetary cannot; buying the wrong one is a full re-buy.

label: Refrigerated display case
source: Restaurant equipment dealer listings, 2024. Curved-glass service cases cost roughly double the grab-and-go equivalent.

label: Soft-serve / frozen yogurt machine
source: Dealer listings, 2024. Pressurized machines overrun more air into the product, which is margin — the price gap pays back in COGS.

label: Retail fit-out per square foot
source: Retail construction cost surveys, 2023-24. A second-generation retail space with usable flooring and lighting halves this.

label: Camera / security system, installed
source: Installer quotes, 2024. Monitoring contracts add $30-80 a month.

label: Exterior signage
source: Sign fabricator quotes, 2024. Permitting and landlord criteria drive more variance than fabrication; some centers dictate the sign vendor.

label: Commercial treadmill / cardio unit
source: Fitness equipment dealer pricing, 2024. Residential-grade units fail in months under commercial duty and void their warranties.

label: Strength station — rack, bar, plates
source: Fitness equipment dealer pricing, 2024. Commercial-duty bars and bumpers, not the residential grade that fails under daily drops.

label: Gym fit-out per square foot
source: Fitness industry buildout surveys, 2023-24, equipment-inclusive at the top tier. Flooring and HVAC upgrades are the underestimated half.

label: Hotel FF&E per key
source: Hotel renovation cost surveys and franchise PIP ranges, 2023-24. A franchise property-improvement plan makes the midscale tier mandatory, not optional.

label: Commercial washer or dryer, each
source: Commercial laundry dealer pricing, 2024. On-premise laundry pays back against linen service at roughly 60+ rooms.

label: Ready-mix batch plant
source: Plant manufacturer quotes and used listings, 2024. Permitting, power and water infrastructure are on top and site-specific.

label: Wheel loader
source: Heavy equipment dealer and auction listings, 2024.

label: Cement silo
source: Heavy equipment listings, 2024. Erection and foundations are on top and can approach the silo price for larger units.

label: Mini excavator
source: Dealer and auction listings, 2024. Renting at $1,500-3,000/month beats owning below ~60% utilisation.

label: Skid steer
source: Heavy equipment dealer and auction listings, 2024. Attachments — forks, augers, breakers — are $2-15k each and are usually the point.

label: Towable generator
source: Heavy equipment listings, 2024. Fuel at load is the real cost of ownership; a 45 kVA unit burns roughly 3 gallons an hour.

label: Scaffolding set
source: Supplier pricing, 2024. Rental is the norm below constant use.

label: Commercial zero-turn mower
source: Dealer pricing, 2024. Residential zero-turns at half the price last one commercial season.

label: Equipment / utility trailer
source: Trailer dealer listings, 2024. GVWR drives both the price and whether a CDL is needed to tow it loaded.

label: Refrigerated van
source: Commercial vehicle listings, 2024. The reefer unit and insulation are $15-30k of the total and age faster than the chassis.

label: Work pickup truck
source: Dealer listings, 2024. Work-spec trim; crew-cab comfort packages add $10-15k and haul nothing extra.

label: Passenger / shuttle van
source: Dealer listings, 2024. An ADA lift adds $15-25k and is required for many contract routes.

label: Developer workstation
source: Retail configuration pricing, 2024. Game development with local builds sits at the top of the band.

label: Telescope, rental-fleet grade
source: Astronomy retailer list prices, 2024. Rental duty favours Dobsonians — fewer motors to break and collimation is the only maintenance.

label: Kennel run buildout, per run
source: Kennel construction supplier pricing, 2024. Drainage and sound attenuation are what separate the tiers — and what inspections check.

label: Grooming tub and table
source: Pet industry supplier pricing, 2024. Electric-lift tables are a workers-comp argument as much as a comfort one.

label: Campground site development, per site
source: Campground development cost guides, 2023-24, excluding land. Utility runs dominate: the far sites cost multiples of the near ones.

label: Commercial septic system
source: Septic contractor quotes, 2024. Soil percolation results decide the tier, and you cannot choose them.

label: Liquor license
source: State ABC fee schedules and quota-state resale listings, 2024. In quota states — Florida, New Jersey, parts of others — licenses trade on a secondary market into six figures, and the band is honest about that.

label: Health department permit, annual
source: County health department fee schedules, 2024.

label: Business formation — LLC filing and basics

tiers.tier: with registered agent and operating agreement

source: State filing fee schedules plus registered-agent pricing, 2024. Attorney-drafted agreements for multi-member LLCs run $1-3k beyond this.

label: Trademark registration
source: USPTO fee schedule plus typical attorney flat fees, 2024.

label: Outsourced bookkeeping, monthly
source: Bookkeeping firm pricing, 2024. Cheaper than a staff bookkeeper below roughly 20 hours a week of work.

label: Business tax preparation, annual
source: CPA firm pricing surveys, 2024. Multi-state nexus and inventory accounting are what push a return into the upper tier.

label: Payroll service, per employee per month
source: Published payroll provider pricing, 2024, excluding the per-run base fee of $20-50.

label: POS software, monthly per location
source: Vendor published pricing, 2024. The hardware is a separate capex line already in this catalog.

label: E-commerce platform, monthly
source: Published platform pricing, 2024. Payment processing is on top and is its own line.

label: Email marketing platform, monthly
source: Published vendor list pricing, 2024. Priced by contact count, so a stale list is a bill as well as a deliverability problem.

label: CRM, per seat per month
source: Published vendor list pricing, 2024. The enterprise tier is mostly permissions and reporting, not more CRM.

label: Game engine license, per seat per year
source: Published Unity pricing, 2024. Unreal charges no seat fee — its 5% royalty above $1M of gross is a separate catalog line.

label: Game engine royalty (Unreal)
source: Published Unreal Engine terms, 2024: 5% of gross above the first $1M per product, waived below it.

label: App / platform store commission
source: Published Apple, Google and Steam terms, 2024. Apple and Google take 15% under their small-business thresholds and 30% above; Steam starts at 30% and steps down only past $10M. This is revenue that never arrives, not a cost you pay.

label: Mobile paid install (CPI)
source: Mobile user-acquisition benchmark reports, 2024, US campaigns. iOS runs above Android; install-to-payer conversion of 2-5% is what turns this into a $20-50 cost per paying subscriber.

label: Search advertising, cost per click
source: Published search advertising benchmarks, 2024. Legal, insurance and finance keywords exceed this band and are not what a small operator should be buying.

label: Social advertising, CPM
source: Published social advertising benchmarks, 2024.

label: SEO / content agency, monthly
source: Agency pricing surveys, 2024. Below $1k/month is usually a report, not a service.

label: Website build, one-time
source: Agency and freelancer pricing surveys, 2024. The template tier assumes your photography; custom assumes theirs.

label: App development, agency-built
source: Agency pricing surveys, 2024. The wide band is honest: scope, not rate, is the variable, and every figure here assumes you are not writing it yourself.

label: Workers’ compensation rate, share of payroll
source: State rating-bureau class rates, 2024. Roofing and steel erection exceed the top of this band. The class code, not negotiation, is what sets it.

label: Liquor liability insurance, annual
source: Broker quote ranges, 2024. Priced off alcohol sales volume and closing time.

label: Commercial auto insurance, per vehicle per year
source: Broker quote ranges, 2024. Radius of operation and driver records move this as much as the vehicle does.

label: Commercial property insurance, annual
source: Broker quote ranges, 2024. Cooking exposure and catastrophe zones set the tier; a sprinklered building earns a real discount.

label: Professional liability / E&O, annual
source: Broker quote ranges, 2024. Claims-made policies need tail coverage when they end, which is the cost people meet at the worst time.

label: Commercial trash service, monthly
source: Hauler pricing, 2024. Restaurants add grease rendering, which is often revenue rather than cost.

label: Hood and duct cleaning, per service
source: Service contractor pricing, 2024. Fire code sets the frequency — quarterly for most full-service kitchens — so this is 4x a year, not optional.

label: Grease trap pumping, per service
source: Service contractor pricing, 2024. Frequency is set by trap size and code, typically monthly to quarterly for a full-service kitchen.

label: Pest control, monthly
source: Service contractor pricing, 2024. Food service pays the higher tier because the visits are documented for health inspections.

label: Linen and uniform service, weekly
source: Linen service pricing, 2024. On-premise laundry beats this above roughly 60 hotel rooms — see the commercial laundry line.

label: Commercial electricity, per kWh
source: EIA state commercial rate tables, 2024. Hawaii exceeds this band. Demand charges for heavy equipment are billed separately and can rival the energy itself.

label: Natural gas, per therm
source: EIA commercial rate tables, 2024. Delivery charges roughly double the commodity price in coastal metros.

label: Business internet, monthly
source: Published ISP business pricing, 2024. The SLA tier buys a repair clock, which matters exactly as much as downtime costs.

label: Music licensing (PROs), annual
source: ASCAP, BMI and SESAC published rate schedules, 2024. Three separate societies, three separate invoices — and they audit. A commercial streaming service with licensing built in covers the background tier.

label: Commissary kitchen rent, monthly
source: Commissary listing rates, 2024. Most health departments require a licensed commissary for a food truck; this line is not optional.

label: Kitchen smallwares, opening set, per seat
source: Restaurant supplier opening-package pricing, 2024. The line every opening budget forgets and every chef re-buys in month two.

label: Food cost, full-service restaurant
source: Industry operating surveys, 2023-24. Sustained readings above the band are a menu-pricing problem, not a purchasing problem.

label: Food and paper cost, quick service
source: Industry operating surveys, 2023-24. Paper and packaging are 3-5 points of this and spike with delivery mix.

label: Pour cost (bar)
source: Bar operating surveys, 2023-24. Above the band means over-pouring or shrinkage; the fix is jiggers and inventory counts, not price.

label: COGS, coffee shop
source: Specialty coffee operating surveys, 2023-24. Milk and cups move this more than beans do.

label: Brewing inputs, per barrel
source: Maltster and hop supplier pricing, 2024 — grain, hops and yeast only. Packaging roughly doubles the per-barrel figure for cans versus draft.

label: COGS, general retail
source: Retail operating surveys, 2023-24. Keystone (2x) markup implies 50%; sustained readings above 62% are wholesale pricing, not retail.

label: Landed COGS, DTC brand
source: DTC operating benchmarks, 2023-24, landed — freight and duty included. Quoting factory cost without freight is the classic understatement.
